about: Template decisions every app starts from. Agents do not reopen these. To change one, write a change request.

decisions.why: What Fernhollow and the Builder already use, and what the agent writes best.
No native engine binary, so it installs in sandboxes and runs on serverless. Prisma's engine download failed in the build sandbox, and the builder agent runs in one too.

decisions.choice: Postgres. Neon in production, one database per app
decisions.why: Real apps need a real database. The benchmark's 'front-end demonstration' scope no longer applies.

decisions.choice: shadcn/ui components copied into src/components/ui, Radix primitives, Tailwind CSS 4 with CSS variable tokens
decisions.why: Accessibility is handled, the code is owned by the app, agents know it well, and the store's look settings can drive every component.
Keeps model and user input inside the schema.

decisions.choice: Playwright end-to-end scripts in e2e/, plus one check per edge in specs/edges.json
decisions.why: Verification is automatic; a run passes only when these pass.

decisions.choice: One GitHub repo per app, one Vercel project per repo, production deploys on merge to main, branch previews for changes
decisions.why: Same flow as Fernhollow. Git holds history, rollback and handoff. Deployed by a publish script, by hand for the first apps.

decisions.choice: Owner-editable settings live in one file, separate from template code. Record the template version per app
decisions.why: Keeps a later move to shared configuration cheap and lets template fixes be applied across apps.

decisions.choice: Stripe, test mode only, until the payments experiment passes
decisions.why: No real money and no customer-facing promise yet.
